Applied Coastal & Ocean Sciences, Ph.D. Program Overview
Blue Economy
This program leverages UNCW’s unique coastal location and has the potential to contribute to the regional and national blue economy.
The blue economy encompasses a broad range of economic and sustainable uses and benefits of the ocean, including fisheries, aquaculture, biotechnology, maritime transport, tourism and recreation, energy and mineral resources, and waste management.
Your research will have a positive impact on the world
You will learn how to get your discoveries out of the lab and into the world, collaborate with entrepreneurs, or become a professional innovator yourself.
